import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

c, v0, v1, a, l = map(int, data)

days = 0
pages_read = 0
current_speed = v0

while pages_read < c:
    days += 1
    if days > 1:
        pages_read -= l
    pages_read += current_speed
    current_speed = min(v1, current_speed + a)

print(days)
